caption: The drawing depicts a metal watering can with a cylindrical body, a long spout extending from the lower left side, and a wide, curved handle attached to the upper right side. The can appears textured, with visible shading to suggest a metallic surface, and two horizontal ridges encircle the body for structural reinforcement. The top of the can has a lid that is slightly ajar, with a small handle on the lid's surface. The image is rendered in grayscale pencil or charcoal on a beige background, giving the objects a monochromatic appearance. The artist's signature, "Mamie Van Felix," is visible in the lower left corner.
title: Oil Can
